gen-fs-nippo-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Mochiy Pop One has a very large lowercase eye, with letters hanging off the line like clothespins. Nippo is the sharper talker up top, its wire-cut strokes feeling technical, while the body font simply carries the sentences along in friendly, rounded type.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-mochiy-pop-p-one: Small letters standing nearly as tall as capitals give Nippo its look. Beneath it, Mochiy Pop P One spreads out with generous gaps between letters and a sizable lowercase, so the wiry heading and the relaxed text never compete.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-montserrat-alternates: Nippo draws its strokes like cut wire, with small letters rising almost to capital height at the top of the page. Montserrat Alternates follows with a wide-mouthed c and crowded lowercase.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-montserrat-underline: Nippo is cut from wire, its small letters standing proud and nearly as tall as its capitals, which gives headings a technical edge. But Montserrat Underline loosens things below, with open counters and oversized lowercase in round bowls of unvarying stroke.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-mozilla-headline: Mozilla Headline has big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal that make text feel approachable. And Nippo, with its wire-like strokes and no heavier downstrokes, can sit above it at a noticeably larger size than the body.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-mozilla-text: Tall bodies make Mozilla Text look bold, and its terminals flare outward. Over a full page it would read with a dense, confident texture, while Nippo's single-weight a, free of hairlines, stays crisp above it.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-nata-sans: Nata Sans reads with a large central band and curved letters that open wide, like a line drawn by technical pen. Nippo adds wire-cut headings with small letters nearly capital height, and the two share a modern, tidy precision.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-nobile: Nobile reads tightly, with almost no gap between lowercase and capitals and mouths left open like unjoined chalk arcs. And across a longer stretch it keeps that compact, brisk rhythm, while Nippo's wire-like headings lack any vertical emphasis or thinning.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-nokora: Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line, with a wide-open s that never tightens. And Nippo's strongest quality is how its wire-like line glides under the eye, a lighter touch than the sturdy text below.
gen-fs-nippo-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic reads openly, with a welcoming gap in the c and capitals barely rising above lowercase. But Nippo does best as a rope-thin outline with no thick or thin parts, while the body font does its best work in steady text.
